objects.description: Producer-side ring structure used by AF_XDP for TX descriptors and FILL addresses. Holds local cached indices, ring size/mask, and shared producer/consumer pointers plus a flags field. Do not access members directly; use helper functions in this header.

Consumer-side ring structure used by AF_XDP for RX descriptors and COMPLETION addresses. Maintains cached indices and pointers to shared indices, plus ring storage and flags. Access via provided helpers only.
Opaque handle representing an AF_XDP UMEM region registered with the kernel. Created and managed via xsk_umem__create* APIs; provides a data buffer area divided into frames used by AF_XDP rings.
Opaque handle to an AF_XDP socket bound to an interface queue, connected to a UMEM and optional RX/TX rings.
Configuration for UMEM creation specifying ring sizes, frame sizing, and flags. Passed to xsk_umem__create/_with_fd; fields default if not set per macros.

Extended UMEM creation options for xsk_umem__create_opts. Allows specifying an existing fd, sizes, flags, and tx metadata length. Unspecified fields fall back to defaults; padding bitfield enforces zero-initialisation of unused tail fields.
Socket configuration used when creating an xsk via legacy create APIs. Sets RX/TX ring sizes, libbpf/libxdp flags, XDP attach flags, and bind flags.

Options for creating an AF_XDP socket with xsk_socket__create_opts. Allows providing ring pointers and sizes plus libxdp/xdp/bind flags. At least one of rx or tx must be non-NULL; fill/comp must be both set or both unset.
Specifies XDP attachment mode for programs: unspecified, native driver, skb/generic, or hardware offload.
Log level enumeration used by libxdp printing callback.
Opaque handle for a single XDP BPF program managed by libxdp. Obtain via xdp_program__from_* or xdp_program__create and manage attach/detach/pin/close via API.
Opaque handle representing a multi-program XDP dispatcher setup on an interface, containing one or more chained xdp_program instances.
Option struct describing how to obtain/create an xdp_program. Exactly one of the documented option groups should be populated; all others must be zero. Used with xdp_program__create.

functions.name: xsk_ring_prod__fill_addr
functions.description: Returns a pointer to the fill ring entry (address slot) at index idx for the producer ring fill. Intended to index into the UMEM fill queue to supply frame addresses to the kernel.
requirements: fill must point to an initialized producer ring for UMEM fill (fields mask, ring, etc. set by libxdp/libbpf).
idx must refer to an entry previously reserved via xsk_ring_prod__reserve or otherwise within the ring size; wrap is handled by mask.
fill->ring must reference an array of 64-bit addresses.

functions.name: xsk_ring_cons__comp_addr
functions.description: Returns a pointer to the completion ring entry (address slot) at index idx for the consumer ring comp. Used to read completed TX buffer addresses from the kernel.
requirements: comp must point to an initialized consumer completion ring (mask, ring, etc. valid).
idx must be within the range that has been peeked via xsk_ring_cons__peek; wrap is handled by mask.
comp->ring must reference an array of 64-bit addresses.

functions.name: xsk_ring_prod__tx_desc
functions.description: Returns a pointer to the TX descriptor at index idx in the producer TX ring. Used by user space to fill TX descriptors before submit.
requirements: tx must point to an initialized producer TX ring (mask, ring, etc. valid).
idx must be within a range reserved with xsk_ring_prod__reserve; wrap handled by mask.
tx->ring must reference an array of struct xdp_desc entries.

functions.name: xsk_ring_cons__rx_desc
functions.signature: const struct xdp_desc *xsk_ring_cons__rx_desc(const struct xsk_ring_cons *rx, __u32 idx)
functions.description: Returns a pointer to the RX descriptor at index idx in the consumer RX ring. Used by user space to read RX descriptors received from the kernel.
requirements: rx must point to an initialized consumer RX ring (mask, ring, etc. valid).
idx must be within the range obtained via xsk_ring_cons__peek; wrap handled by mask.
rx->ring must reference an array of struct xdp_desc entries.

functions.name: xsk_ring_prod__needs_wakeup
functions.description: Returns non-zero if the producer ring indicates the kernel should be woken up (XDP_RING_NEED_WAKEUP flag set). Used to decide whether to kick the kernel with poll/sendto/syscall.
requirements: r must point to an initialized producer ring with flags pointing to a valid flags field.

functions.name: xsk_prod_nb_free
functions.description: Returns the number of free entries in the producer ring r, refreshing cached consumer index if needed. Typically used to check capacity before reserving entries.
requirements: r must be an initialized producer ring (cached_prod/cons, mask, size, producer/consumer pointers valid).
nb is the required number of entries (any 32-bit value); the function returns available count which may be less than nb.

functions.name: xsk_cons_nb_avail
functions.description: Returns up to nb available entries in the consumer ring r, refreshing cached producer index if needed. Used to determine how many entries can be consumed.
requirements: r must be an initialized consumer ring (cached_prod/cons, mask, size, producer/consumer pointers valid).
nb is the maximum number of entries the caller wishes to consume.

functions.name: xsk_ring_prod__reserve
functions.description: Attempts to reserve nb contiguous entries on the producer ring. On success, writes the starting ring index to *idx and returns nb; otherwise returns 0.
requirements: prod must be an initialized producer ring.
idx must be a non-NULL pointer to receive the starting index.
Caller must only write to the reserved range [*idx, *idx+nb) and later call xsk_ring_prod__submit with the same count to publish entries.
nb must be > 0 to reserve any entries.

functions.name: xsk_ring_prod__submit
functions.description: Publishes nb previously-reserved producer ring entries to the kernel by advancing the producer index with release semantics.
requirements: prod must be an initialized producer ring.
nb must match the number of entries previously reserved and filled by the caller since the last submit.
All writes to the reserved ring entries must be completed before calling submit (function enforces ordering for producer index only).

functions.name: xsk_ring_cons__peek
functions.description: Returns up to nb available entries on the consumer ring and, if non-zero, sets *idx to the starting index and advances the cached consumer index by the number returned.
requirements: cons must be an initialized consumer ring.
idx must be non-NULL if the function is expected to return entries (>0).
Caller must process exactly the number of entries returned, or adjust via xsk_ring_cons__cancel before release.

functions.name: xsk_ring_cons__cancel
functions.description: Cancels consumption of nb entries previously obtained via peek by rolling back the cached consumer index. Does not update the kernel-visible consumer pointer.
requirements: cons must be an initialized consumer ring.
nb must not exceed the number of entries last peeked and not yet released.

functions.name: xsk_ring_cons__release
functions.description: Releases nb consumed entries to the kernel by advancing the consumer index with release semantics. Signals that the entries are processed.
requirements: cons must be an initialized consumer ring.
nb must be the number of entries being released that were previously peeked and not canceled.

functions.name: xsk_umem__get_data
functions.description: Returns a pointer to data within the UMEM area at byte offset addr. Helper for translating UMEM frame addresses to user-space pointers.
requirements: umem_area must point to the start of the mapped UMEM memory region.
addr must be within the bounds of the UMEM region size; no bounds checking is performed.

functions.name: xsk_umem__extract_addr
functions.description: Extracts the base address portion from a composed unaligned buffer address by masking with XSK_UNALIGNED_BUF_ADDR_MASK.
requirements: addr is a composed UMEM address that may contain an offset encoded per XSK_UNALIGNED_BUF_* constants.

functions.name: xsk_umem__extract_offset
functions.description: Extracts the offset portion from a composed unaligned buffer address by shifting right by XSK_UNALIGNED_BUF_OFFSET_SHIFT.
requirements: addr is a composed UMEM address containing an encoded offset per XSK_UNALIGNED_BUF_* constants.

functions.name: xsk_umem__add_offset_to_addr
functions.description: Combines the base address and the encoded offset components from a composed UMEM address into a linear byte address (base + offset).
requirements: addr is a composed UMEM address as produced/expected by AF_XDP for unaligned buffers.

functions.name: xsk_umem__fd
functions.description: Returns the file descriptor associated with the given UMEM.
requirements: umem must be a valid UMEM handle returned by xsk_umem__create/_create_with_fd/_create_opts.

functions.name: xsk_socket__fd
functions.description: Returns the AF_XDP socket file descriptor associated with the xsk socket.
requirements: xsk must be a valid xsk socket handle returned by xsk_socket__create/_create_shared/_create_opts.

functions.name: xsk_setup_xdp_prog
functions.description: Sets up an XDP program on the interface ifindex suitable for AF_XDP use and returns the xsks_map file descriptor via xsks_map_fd.
requirements: ifindex must refer to a valid network interface.
xsks_map_fd must be non-NULL to receive the map FD.
Caller must have sufficient privileges to load/attach XDP programs.

functions.name: xsk_socket__update_xskmap
functions.description: Updates the provided xsks_map with the AF_XDP socket mapping for xsk, enabling kernel redirection to the socket.
requirements: xsk must be a valid AF_XDP socket handle.
xsks_map_fd must be a valid file descriptor for an xsks_map BPF map with appropriate key for the socket's queue/ifindex.
Caller must have permissions to update the BPF map.

functions.name: xsk_umem__create
functions.signature: int xsk_umem__create(struct xsk_umem **umem, void *umem_area, __u64 size, struct xsk_ring_prod *fill, struct xsk_ring_cons *comp, const struct xsk_umem_config *config)
functions.description: Creates a UMEM backing region for AF_XDP using the provided memory area and size, optionally initializing fill and completion rings. If config is NULL, default configuration is used.
requirements: umem must be non-NULL; on success *umem receives a valid handle.
umem_area must point to a memory region of at least size bytes; alignment/page requirements depend on config; if config is NULL defaults apply.
size must be the UMEM area size in bytes and non-zero.
fill and comp, if non-NULL, must point to ring structs to be initialized for fill/completion.
Set config to NULL to use default configuration values as per header comment.

functions.name: xsk_umem__create_with_fd
functions.signature: int xsk_umem__create_with_fd(struct xsk_umem **umem, int fd, void *umem_area, __u64 size, struct xsk_ring_prod *fill, struct xsk_ring_cons *comp, const struct xsk_umem_config *config)
functions.description: Creates a UMEM using an existing file descriptor fd, otherwise like xsk_umem__create.
requirements: umem must be non-NULL; on success *umem receives a valid handle.
fd must be a valid socket/UMEM fd suitable for AF_XDP UMEM setup.
umem_area must point to a memory region of at least size bytes.
size must be non-zero.
fill and comp, if non-NULL, must point to ring structs to be initialized.
config may be NULL to use defaults.

functions.name: xsk_umem__create_opts
functions.signature: struct xsk_umem *xsk_umem__create_opts(void *umem_area, struct xsk_ring_prod *fill, struct xsk_ring_cons *comp, struct xsk_umem_opts *opts)
functions.description: Creates a UMEM using an options struct, returning the UMEM handle directly. Preferred API over the older create functions. Optional fields in opts allow specifying an existing fd, size, ring sizes, frame parameters, and flags; unspecified fields take defaults.
requirements: umem_area must point to the backing memory region; if opts->size is unset, umem_area must be page-aligned (per header comment on xsk_umem_opts).
fill and comp may be both unset or both set; setting only one is invalid per opts documentation for sockets, but UMEM opts comment allows both unset and remaining fields defaulted.
opts may be NULL or must be initialized with sz and optional fields documented in struct xsk_umem_opts; unspecified fields take defaults.
If opts->fd is unset, a new sockfd will be created (per header comment).

functions.name: xsk_socket__create
functions.signature: int xsk_socket__create(struct xsk_socket **xsk, const char *ifname, __u32 queue_id, struct xsk_umem *umem, struct xsk_ring_cons *rx, struct xsk_ring_prod *tx, const struct xsk_socket_config *config)
functions.description: Creates an AF_XDP socket bound to interface ifname and queue_id using the given UMEM and optional RX/TX rings. Configuration defaults apply if config is NULL.
requirements: xsk must be non-NULL; on success *xsk receives a valid handle.
ifname must be a valid network interface name string.
queue_id selects the queue on the interface.
umem must be a valid UMEM handle.
At least one of rx or tx should be provided in general AF_XDP usage; header opts mention that at least one direction should be assigned.
config may be NULL to use default values.

functions.name: xsk_socket__create_shared
functions.signature: int xsk_socket__create_shared(struct xsk_socket **xsk_ptr, const char *ifname, __u32 queue_id, struct xsk_umem *umem, struct xsk_ring_cons *rx, struct xsk_ring_prod *tx, struct xsk_ring_prod *fill, struct xsk_ring_cons *comp, const struct xsk_socket_config *config)
functions.description: Creates an AF_XDP socket that can share rings/UMEM with another socket, allowing explicit provision of fill and comp rings in addition to rx/tx. Configuration defaults apply if config is NULL.
requirements: xsk_ptr must be non-NULL; on success *xsk_ptr receives a valid handle.
ifname must name a valid network interface; queue_id selects the queue.
umem must be a valid UMEM handle.
rx/tx and fill/comp ring pointers must point to ring structs corresponding to the UMEM and socket; combinations must be consistent.
config may be NULL to use default values.

functions.name: xsk_socket__create_opts
functions.signature: struct xsk_socket *xsk_socket__create_opts(const char *ifname, __u32 queue_id, struct xsk_umem *umem, struct xsk_socket_opts *opts)
functions.description: Creates an AF_XDP socket using an options struct. Preferred API. Options can specify rings, sizes, flags, and bind/XDP mode; unspecified fields default as described in xsk_socket_opts.
requirements: ifname must be a valid interface name; queue_id selects the target RX/TX queue.
umem must be a valid UMEM handle.
opts may be NULL or must be initialized with sz and documented fields; defaults apply when fields are unset.
Per header: rx and tx should not be NULL at the same time (at least one direction must be assigned).
Per header: if fill and comp are both unset they will default to UMEM’s saved rings; setting only one of fill/comp is invalid.

functions.name: xsk_umem__delete
functions.description: Deletes the UMEM handle, releasing associated resources. Returns 0 on success or -EBUSY if the UMEM is still in use by sockets.
requirements: umem must be a UMEM handle previously created by this API.
Caller should ensure all sockets using the UMEM are closed to avoid -EBUSY.

functions.name: xsk_socket__delete
functions.description: Deletes the AF_XDP socket and releases associated resources.
requirements: xsk must be a socket handle previously created by this API.
After deletion, the handle must not be used.

functions.name: libxdp_set_print
functions.description: Sets a custom logging callback for libxdp and returns the previous callback.
requirements: fn must be a function matching libxdp_print_fn_t signature (int (*)(enum libxdp_print_level, const char *, va_list)).
The callback must remain valid for as long as libxdp may invoke it.

functions.name: libxdp_get_error
functions.description: Returns a negative error code stored in a libxdp pointer-like return value, or 0 if no error. Similar to libbpf_get_error semantics.
requirements: ptr should be a pointer returned by libxdp APIs that embed error codes in pointer values.
Return value is 0 on success or a negative errno on failure.

functions.name: libxdp_strerror
functions.signature: int libxdp_strerror(int err, char *buf, size_t size)
functions.description: Converts err (usually a negative errno) to a human-readable string written to buf of length size. Returns 0 on success or a negative error.
requirements: buf must be a valid writable buffer of at least size bytes.
size indicates the buffer length; if too small, the message may be truncated.

functions.name: libxdp_clean_references
functions.description: Cleans up libxdp-related references (e.g., pinned maps/program links) for the given interface index. Useful for teardown or recovery.
requirements: ifindex must refer to a valid network interface.
Caller must have permissions to modify/remove kernel-side references.

functions.name: xdp_program__from_bpf_obj
functions.description: Creates an xdp_program handle from a loaded/opened bpf_object, selecting the program in section section_name (or default if NULL).
requirements: obj must be a valid bpf_object pointer opened via libbpf.
section_name may be NULL or must name a valid program section within obj.

functions.name: xdp_program__find_file
functions.signature: struct xdp_program *xdp_program__find_file(const char *filename, const char *section_name, struct bpf_object_open_opts *opts)
functions.description: Finds and opens an XDP program from a BPF object located via LIBXDP_OBJECT_PATH using filename, optionally selecting section_name and open options.
requirements: filename must be a valid filename present in LIBXDP_OBJECT_PATH.
section_name may be NULL or must match a program section.
opts may be NULL or a valid bpf_object_open_opts pointer.

functions.name: xdp_program__open_file
functions.signature: struct xdp_program *xdp_program__open_file(const char *filename, const char *section_name, struct bpf_object_open_opts *opts)
functions.description: Opens an XDP program from a BPF object at the given filesystem path filename, selecting section_name if provided and applying open options.
requirements: filename must be a valid path to a BPF ELF object.
section_name may be NULL or must match a program section in the object.
opts may be NULL or a valid bpf_object_open_opts pointer.

functions.name: xdp_program__from_fd
functions.description: Creates an xdp_program handle from an existing BPF program file descriptor.
requirements: fd must be a valid file descriptor referring to a BPF program.

functions.name: xdp_program__from_id
functions.description: Creates an xdp_program handle from a kernel BPF program ID.
requirements: prog_id must be a valid existing BPF program ID.

functions.name: xdp_program__from_pin
functions.description: Creates an xdp_program handle from a BPF program pinned in bpffs at pin_path.
requirements: pin_path must be a valid path to a pinned BPF program in bpffs.
Caller must have permissions to access bpffs.

functions.name: xdp_program__clone
functions.signature: struct xdp_program *xdp_program__clone(struct xdp_program *xdp_prog, unsigned int flags)
functions.description: Clones an existing xdp_program handle, possibly altering attributes per flags.
requirements: xdp_prog must be a valid xdp_program handle.
flags meaning is library-defined; unknown from header.

functions.name: xdp_program__close
functions.description: Closes and frees an xdp_program handle and associated resources.
requirements: xdp_prog must be a handle previously obtained from libxdp.
After closing, the handle must not be used.

functions.name: xdp_program__test_run
functions.signature: int xdp_program__test_run(struct xdp_program *xdp_prog, struct bpf_test_run_opts *opts, unsigned int flags)
functions.description: Runs the XDP program in test mode using bpf_test_run_opts, returning the result code from the kernel. Used for offline verification/benchmarking.
requirements: xdp_prog must be a valid xdp_program handle referring to a loaded program.
opts must be initialized per libbpf bpf_test_run_opts requirements.
flags are library-defined; unknown from header.
Caller must have CAP_BPF or appropriate permissions for BPF_PROG_TEST_RUN.

functions.name: xdp_program__is_attached
functions.signature: enum xdp_attach_mode xdp_program__is_attached(const struct xdp_program *xdp_prog, int ifindex)
functions.description: Returns the attach mode (native, skb, hw, or unspec) indicating whether and how the program is attached to interface ifindex.
requirements: xdp_prog must be a valid program handle.
ifindex must refer to a network interface.

functions.name: xdp_program__name
functions.description: Returns the program name string for the XDP program.
requirements: xdp_prog must be valid; returned pointer remains valid while the handle is alive.

functions.name: xdp_program__tag
functions.description: Returns a pointer to the 8-byte BPF program tag (hash) for the XDP program.
requirements: xdp_prog must be valid; pointer validity tied to the handle lifetime.

functions.name: xdp_program__bpf_obj
functions.description: Returns the underlying libbpf bpf_object for the XDP program.
requirements: xdp_prog must be valid.
Returned bpf_object is owned by libxdp; do not close it independently unless documented.

functions.name: xdp_program__btf
functions.description: Returns the BTF metadata object associated with the XDP program, if any.
requirements: xdp_prog must be valid.

functions.name: xdp_program__id
functions.description: Returns the kernel program ID of the XDP program.
requirements: xdp_prog must be valid.

functions.name: xdp_program__fd
functions.description: Returns the file descriptor of the loaded BPF program for the XDP program.
requirements: xdp_prog must be valid.

functions.name: xdp_program__run_prio
functions.description: Returns the run priority of the XDP program within a multiprog chain.
requirements: xdp_prog must be valid.

functions.name: xdp_program__set_run_prio
functions.signature: int xdp_program__set_run_prio(struct xdp_program *xdp_prog, unsigned int run_prio)
functions.description: Sets the run priority for the program when part of a chained dispatcher.
requirements: xdp_prog must be valid.
run_prio must be a valid priority value per library semantics (exact range unknown).

functions.name: xdp_program__chain_call_enabled
functions.signature: bool xdp_program__chain_call_enabled(const struct xdp_program *xdp_prog, enum xdp_action action)
functions.description: Returns whether chain-calling to the next program is enabled when this program returns the given XDP action.
requirements: xdp_prog must be valid.
action must be a valid enum xdp_action value.

functions.name: xdp_program__set_chain_call_enabled
functions.signature: int xdp_program__set_chain_call_enabled(struct xdp_program *prog, unsigned int action, bool enabled)
functions.description: Enables or disables chain-calling to the next program for the specified action.
requirements: prog must be valid.
action must be a valid XDP action code.
enabled selects enable/disable.

functions.name: xdp_program__print_chain_call_actions
functions.signature: int xdp_program__print_chain_call_actions(const struct xdp_program *prog, char *buf, size_t buf_len)
functions.description: Writes a textual representation of the actions for which chain-calling is enabled into buf.
requirements: prog must be valid.
buf must be a writable buffer of at least buf_len bytes.

functions.name: xdp_program__xdp_frags_support
functions.description: Returns whether XDP frags (multi-buffer) support is enabled for the program.
requirements: prog must be valid.

functions.name: xdp_program__set_xdp_frags_support
functions.description: Enables or disables XDP frags (multi-buffer) support for the program.
requirements: prog must be valid.
frags indicates desired enable state.

functions.name: xdp_program__pin
functions.description: Pins the program in bpffs at pin_path for persistence and later retrieval.
requirements: xdp_prog must be valid and loaded.
pin_path must be a valid path in a mounted BPF filesystem.
Caller must have permissions to create entries in bpffs.

functions.name: xdp_program__attach
functions.signature: int xdp_program__attach(struct xdp_program *xdp_prog, int ifindex, enum xdp_attach_mode mode, unsigned int flags)
functions.description: Attaches the XDP program to the given interface in the specified attach mode.
requirements: xdp_prog must be valid and loaded.
ifindex must refer to a valid network interface.
mode must be one of enum xdp_attach_mode.
Caller must have privileges to attach XDP programs.
flags are library-defined; unknown from header.

functions.name: xdp_program__attach_multi
functions.signature: int xdp_program__attach_multi(struct xdp_program **progs, size_t num_progs, int ifindex, enum xdp_attach_mode mode, unsigned int flags)
functions.description: Attaches multiple XDP programs as a chain to the given interface.
requirements: progs must point to an array of num_progs valid xdp_program handles.
num_progs must match the array length and be > 0.
ifindex must be a valid interface index.
mode must be a valid enum xdp_attach_mode.
Caller must have privileges to attach XDP programs.
flags are library-defined; unknown from header.

functions.name: xdp_program__detach
functions.signature: int xdp_program__detach(struct xdp_program *xdp_prog, int ifindex, enum xdp_attach_mode mode, unsigned int flags)
functions.description: Detaches the XDP program from the given interface and mode.
requirements: xdp_prog must be valid.
ifindex must refer to a network interface.
mode must be a valid enum xdp_attach_mode.
Caller must have privileges to detach XDP programs.
flags are library-defined; unknown from header.

functions.name: xdp_program__detach_multi
functions.signature: int xdp_program__detach_multi(struct xdp_program **progs, size_t num_progs, int ifindex, enum xdp_attach_mode mode, unsigned int flags)
functions.description: Detaches a chain of XDP programs from the given interface.
requirements: progs must be an array of num_progs handles previously attached as a chain.
num_progs must be > 0.
ifindex and mode must be valid.
Caller must have privileges to detach XDP programs.
flags are library-defined; unknown from header.

functions.name: xdp_multiprog__get_from_ifindex
functions.description: Retrieves a handle representing the XDP program stack attached to the given interface.
requirements: ifindex must refer to a valid network interface.

functions.name: xdp_multiprog__next_prog
functions.signature: struct xdp_program *xdp_multiprog__next_prog(const struct xdp_program *prog, const struct xdp_multiprog *mp)
functions.description: Iterator helper: returns the next program in a multiprogram chain after prog for the given multiprog mp, or the first if prog is NULL.
requirements: mp must be a valid multiprog handle.
prog must be NULL or a program contained in mp.

functions.name: xdp_multiprog__close
functions.description: Closes and frees a multiprog handle.
requirements: mp must be a handle previously obtained from libxdp.
After closing, the handle must not be used.

functions.name: xdp_multiprog__detach
functions.description: Detaches all programs represented by the multiprog handle from the interface.
requirements: mp must be valid.
Caller must have privileges to detach XDP programs.

functions.name: xdp_multiprog__attach_mode
functions.description: Returns the attach mode (native, skb, hw, or unspec) of the multiprog on its interface.
requirements: mp must be valid.

functions.name: xdp_multiprog__main_prog
functions.description: Returns the main/dispatcher program of the multiprog chain, if any.
requirements: mp must be valid.

functions.name: xdp_multiprog__hw_prog
functions.description: Returns the hardware offloaded XDP program in the chain, if any.
requirements: mp must be valid.

functions.name: xdp_multiprog__is_legacy
functions.description: Returns true if the interface is using the legacy single-prog XDP attach mechanism rather than a dispatcher.
requirements: mp must be valid.

functions.name: xdp_multiprog__program_count
functions.description: Returns the number of programs in the multiprog chain, or a negative error code.
requirements: mp must be valid.

functions.name: xdp_multiprog__xdp_frags_support
functions.description: Returns whether XDP frags support is enabled across the multiprog.
requirements: mp must be valid.

functions.name: xdp_program__create
functions.description: Creates an XDP program handle based on the provided options. Only certain combinations of fields in opts may be set at once as documented in xdp_program_opts; others must be zeroed.
requirements: opts must be initialized with sz and only one of the documented field combinations set (obj/prog_name; find_filename/prog_name/opts; open_filename/prog_name/opts; id; fd).
All other members of opts must be zeroed out when one combination is used (per header comment).

endpoints.name: xsk_umem__get_data
xsk_umem__extract_addr
xsk_umem__extract_offset
xsk_umem__add_offset_to_addr

unharnessable_functions.name: xsk_ring_prod__fill_addr
unharnessable_functions.reason: Requires an initialized producer fill ring with persistent backing storage, which cannot be safely provided without accessing internal fields and maintaining lifetime across stubs.

unharnessable_functions.name: xsk_ring_cons__comp_addr
